applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Create applications and manage SANDBOX credentials. Use Explorer to try published operations with a selected application.
applications.empty: No applications yet. Create one to get started.
applications.archive_confirm: Archive this application? It can no longer create credentials.
applications.rotate_confirm: Rotate this credential? The current secret will stop working after you save the new one.
applications.revoke_confirm: Revoke this credential? This cannot be undone.
applications.revoke_confirm_keycloak: Revoke disables the Keycloak client binding for this credential. Existing tokens may fail until expiry; create a new credential to restore access.
applications.field_code_pattern: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only
applications.field_code_hint: Stable external code used in client_id (normalized to lowercase).
applications.save_secret_warning: Important: save the API Secret now. You will not be able to view it again after closing.

productionAccess.title: Production Access
productionAccess.subtitle: Manage LIVE credentials and webhooks for real production traffic. API Explorer is Sandbox-only.
productionAccess.risk_body: LIVE credentials and webhooks affect production payments. There is no Explorer try-it for LIVE. Confirm carefully before create, revoke, or disable.
productionAccess.apps_empty_hint: Create an application on the Applications tab first. The same application is used for both Sandbox and LIVE — there is no separate LIVE application.
productionAccess.create_ux_note: Create is disabled in the UI when an ACTIVE LIVE credential already exists or the application is archived. Concurrent or direct API calls may still return HTTP 409 — backend single-ACTIVE is the source of truth.
productionAccess.create_live_warning: This issues production API access. Secrets are shown once.
productionAccess.create_live_confirm_body: Continue only if you intend to call the production API with this application.
productionAccess.revoke_confirm_body: Revoke disables the Keycloak client for this credential. This cannot be undone; create a new LIVE credential afterward if needed. G7.1 does not offer Rotate in this panel.
productionAccess.live_webhook_env_fixed: Environment is fixed to LIVE for this create flow.
productionAccess.disable_confirm: Disable this LIVE webhook? New deliveries will stop; in-flight attempts continue.
productionAccess.enable_confirm: Re-enable this LIVE webhook for new deliveries?
productionAccess.checklist_subtitle: Configuration preview only. This does not certify production readiness or enable/disable access.

Developer.generate_confirm_content: Are you sure you want to generate or reset API credentials? This will invalidate your current credentials.

Developer.webhook_endpoints_desc: Konfigurieren Sie Webhook-Endpunkte, um Ereignisbenachrichtigungen zu empfangen.

Developer.webhook_event_types_required: Select at least one event type
Developer.webhook_created_save_secret: Webhook created: save your Webhook Secret now.
Developer.webhook_deliveries_desc: Sehen Sie sich den Verlauf der an Ihren Server gesendeten Webhook-Ereignisse an. Wenn Sie erwartete Ereignisse nicht sehen oder Zustellungen fehlschlagen, prüfen Sie die Verfügbarkeit Ihres Endpunkts.

sandbox.title: Payment Integration Verification
sandbox.subtitle: Run Open API flows in the console to verify your integration.
sandbox.no_credentials: Enter Client ID and Secret below, or create a SANDBOX credential under Applications if you do not have one yet.
sandbox.webhook_poll_description: Complete payment and ensure a webhook endpoint is configured. We will poll delivery records for a successful payment.success event for this order.
sandbox.webhook_poll_hint: After payment succeeds, FilixPay will POST to your webhook URL. This step checks delivery records automatically.
sandbox.webhook_poll_pending: No successful webhook delivery yet. Complete payment and try again.
sandbox.field_order_item_hint: Test order uses a single line item.

technical.no_steps_yet: Run a step to see request and code samples.

sandbox.credentials_form_hint: Enter your SANDBOX Client ID and Secret to start verification. Client ID is prefilled when an active credential is found; Secret is only shown once at creation and must be pasted here.
sandbox.client_secret_hint: Secret cannot be retrieved after the create/rotate dialog is closed. Use a saved secret or rotate under Applications.
sandbox.restart_success: Session cleared. Enter Client ID and Secret to start again.
sandbox.session_active_hint: A verification session is already running, so the credential form is hidden. Use “Restart with credentials” to enter Client ID and Secret again.
sandbox.step_failed_hint: Expand Technical Details below for the API response. If credentials look wrong, restart and paste the SANDBOX Client Secret again.

explorer.title: Sandbox API Explorer
explorer.subtitle: Select an Application and operation, then execute via the server-side Explorer proxy. Credentials and tokens stay on the server.
explorer.header_hint: Only Artifact-declared headers. Do not send Authorization, Cookie, or merchant/org headers.

Developer.webhook_disable_confirm: Disable this webhook? New deliveries will stop; in-flight attempts continue.

Developer.webhook_environment_fixed: Environment is fixed for this tab.
Developer.webhook_url_hint: We send POST requests to this URL. Respond with HTTP 200 OK. LIVE requires HTTPS; SANDBOX also allows http://localhost.

TransactionPassword.title: Transaction Password
TransactionPassword.subtitle: Manage your transaction PIN to protect withdrawals, transfers, and other sensitive fund operations.
TransactionPassword.security_desc: The transaction password is a 6-digit PIN required for sensitive fund operations such as withdrawals and transfers, providing an extra layer of security for your account.
TransactionPassword.password_desc_suffix: . It is required for withdrawals, large transfers, and other sensitive fund operations to protect your account.
security_tips: Do not use the same password as your login credentials.
Filix support will never ask for your transaction PIN.
Change your transaction PIN periodically to improve account security.
TransactionPassword.password_desc_set: Your transaction password is active. You can update it here.
TransactionPassword.password_desc_unset: You haven't set a transaction password yet. Set one now to secure your funds.
